jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**


State Street’s Global Product organisation is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and is recruiting for a Senior Manager in the Product Control space to join the team and help take the business forward by developing and providing analytics and reporting to support key initiatives and inform decisions.

**Why this role is important to us**


The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting\-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

**What you will be responsible for**


As Product Control Senior Manager you will

* Commercials analysis on various business lines in Custody, Digital and Fund Services
* Data sourcing on various business metrics and financial reporting
* Development and maintenance of new solutions build in BI tools, including Sigma
* Creating data models and enhancing datasets for Product analytics, such as Transaction analytics, AuC trends, pricing model and predictive analytics.
* Work across functions and finance teams to understand business impacts of AuC and transaction trends, Sales pipeline and targets.

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* Finance or Product P\&L management background
* Data management / data visualisation techniques (PowerBI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL query)
* Good understanding of the various product families; Custody, Accounting, Liquidity, Depositary and Performance
* Strong analytical and presentation skills, using MS Office suite.
* Good stakeholder management skills with an ability to navigate organisation through the solution delivery cycle.
* Track record of solving data integration challenges across complex and at scale data sets

**Experience**

* 10\+ years’ experience in Asset Servicing / Securities Services
* Worked in Product organisations in prior roles.
* Prior experience working in Product / Finance / Technology/ Controller.
* Strong team player who can thrive in a large complex global organization.

**About State Street**

* **What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.
* **Work, Live and Grow**. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
* State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.
* Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Tribute Technology is an established best\-in\-class Software as a Service technology company and solutions provider. Our customers include some of the largest and most prominent media brands in the world, spanning 4 continents and reaching millions of users every day. Our mission is to make meaningful connections between our customers and their users through innovation and a commitment to excellent user experience.  


**ABOUT TRIBUTE TECHNOLOGY:**



At Tribute Technology, we make end\-of\-life celebrations memorable, meaningful, and effortless through thoughtful and innovative technology solutions. Our mission is to help communities around the world celebrate life and pay tribute to those we love. Our comprehensive platform brings together software and technology to provide a fully integrated experience for all users, whether that is a family, a funeral home, or an online publisher. We are the market leader in the US and Canada, with global expansion plans and a growing international team of more than 400 individuals in the US, Canada, Philippines, Ukraine and India.

  

**ABOUT YOU:**



We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) team. You’ll build and optimize customer\-facing experiences that power thousands of websites across North America, using experimentation and data\-driven insights to improve conversion and user engagement.



This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys owning features from concept through production. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, Analytics, and Engineering teams while making sound technical decisions independently in a fast\-paced environment.



Our engineering team is experienced and self\-sustaining, so we’re looking for someone who can contribute immediately, deliver high\-quality software, and take pride in building reliable, production\-ready solutions.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


**Develop Customer\-Facing Solutions:**


* Design, develop, and maintain customer\-facing web applications using PHP, C\#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL.
* Build scalable, maintainable, and performant solutions that improve customer experience across thousands of customer websites.
* Deliver clean, reusable, and well\-tested code following engineering best practices.


**Drive Experimentation \& Optimization:**


* Design, implement, and optimize A/B and multivariate experiments that improve conversion rates and customer engagement.
* Build experiments using platforms such as Optimizely, VWO, Convert, or similar experimentation tools.
* Partner with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Analytics teams to translate business hypotheses into measurable experiments.
* Validate experiment implementation to ensure accurate targeting, tracking, and reporting.


**Build Reliable Production Software:**


* Own features throughout the software development lifecycle—from design and implementation to deployment and production support.
* Troubleshoot production issues and deliver timely, reliable fixes.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.


**Champion Quality:**


* Perform thorough self\-testing and validate implementations before submitting code for review, ensuring customer experiences and experiments behave exactly as intended.
* Take ownership of delivering high\-quality software with minimal defects.
* Collaborate closely with QA and engineering teams to ensure successful releases


**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building customer\-facing web applications.
* Proven experience implementing A/B testing and multivariate experimentation.
* Hands\-on experience using experimentation platforms such as Optimizely, VWO, Convert, or similar.
* Experience building and maintaining production web applications.
* Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex features in a collaborative engineering environment.


**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**


* Strong experience with PHP development.
* Experience with C\#/.NET development.
* Advanced JavaScript, HTML, and CSS skills.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience.
* Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Experience with Cloudflare and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
* Experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe, PayPal, or similar payment gateways.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.


**NICE TO HAVE:**



* Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, FullStory, or similar analytics platforms.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or New Relic.
* Experience working on high\-traffic, customer\-facing e\-commerce platforms.


**HOW YOU WORK:**



* You take ownership and independently drive work from requirements through production.
* You have exceptional attention to detail and consistently self\-test before submitting code for review.
* You write clean, maintainable, and reliable software with a strong focus on quality.
* You communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and thrive in a collaborative Agile team.
* You enjoy solving business problems through experimentation and continuous improvement.


**BENEFITS:**


* Competitive salary
* Fully remote across India
* An outstanding collaborative work environment


*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.*

jobs.description:
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (In\-Office)


**Target Markets:** India \& Australia


**Experience Level:** 2–4 Years


**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Founders


**About Us:**


At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high\-transaction, data\-rich industries across India and Australia.


**The Role:**


We are seeking a creative, data\-driven, and multi\-faceted **Social Media \& Omnichannel Marketing Executive** to join our growth marketing team in Hyderabad.


In this role, you won't just manage a single social page—you will own our brand’s digital footprint across organic social, paid advertising, and direct engagement channels like Email and WhatsApp. You will design, execute, and optimize cross\-channel campaigns aimed at capturing the attention of B2B retail business owners and C\-level executives in both India and Australia.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Social Media Marketing (Organic \& Paid Ads):**


* **Organic Strategy:** Plan, create, and schedule engaging content across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and Instagram that establishes Zithara.ai as a thought leader in Martech and AI.
* **Paid Campaigns:** Set up, monitor, and optimize paid ad campaigns on **LinkedIn Campaign Manager** and **Meta Ads Manager** to generate high\-quality demo requests and inbound leads.
* **A/B Testing:** Continuously test ad creatives, hooks, and audience segments (specifically targeting the Retail/E\-commerce landscape in IN and AU) to maximize ROAS and lower Cost Per Lead (CPL).

**2\. Omnichannel Execution (Email \& WhatsApp Marketing):**


* **Email Campaigns:** Build, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns for inbound nurture tracks, cold outbound sequences, and monthly product newsletters.
* **WhatsApp Marketing:** Design and deploy conversational WhatsApp marketing workflows for event promotions (like trade shows), webinars, and direct lead re\-engagement.
* **Analytics Tracking:** Monitor key messaging metrics including open rates, click\-through rates (CTR), spam scores, and conversion rates to iterate on copy and targeting.

**3\. Content Creation \& Event Support:**


* **Copywriting:** Write compelling, persuasive copy for ad creatives, email subject lines, WhatsApp broadcasts, and long\-form social posts.
* **Collateral Coordination:** Collaborate with graphic designers or utilize tools like Canva to produce crisp, thumb\-stopping visual assets and video shorts.
* **Event Amplification:** Create buzz around major industry events and exhibitions (e.g., pre\-booking campaigns for retail trade shows) to drive foot traffic and booth appointments.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* **Experience:** 2–4 years of proven marketing experience, ideally within a **B2B SaaS or Martech company**.
* **Paid Ads Mastery:** Hands\-on experience managing and scaling budgets on LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience using modern marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Mailchimp, Intercom, or native WhatsApp API setups). High proficiency with Canva or basic video editing apps is a major plus.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Stellar written and verbal English communication skills. You must be able to write sharp, professional copy that resonates with business leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** You don't just post content; you actively track impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue metrics to justify marketing spend.
* **Location \& Shift Awareness:** Based in Hyderabad. Willingness to occasionally align campaign scheduling and optimization tracking to match Australian business hours.

**What to Expect (Why Join Us):**


**"Drink Your Own Champagne"** \> You will be marketing a world\-class platform using the exact channels our platform automates. Your success stories will directly form the case studies we show our clients.


* **High\-Growth Environment:** Be part of an agile startup team where your ideas are implemented fast, and your impact is visible daily.
* **Advanced Tech Stack:** Work directly alongside AI engineers and SaaS growth experts, picking up cutting\-edge knowledge in AI agents and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive base salary with performance incentives tied directly to pipeline contribution and lead generation.

Zithara.ai is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company.

Commercial Engineering \& AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done \- at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers. Success in this role is measured not by features shipped, but by the impact delivered to customers, support operations, and Microsoft's AI\-first transformation.


This role offers the opportunity to directly drive the evolution of AI\-powered customer support systems at Microsoft. You will work on systems that operate at global scale, deliver measurable customer and business impact, and shape how intelligent agents are applied to real\-world support workflows. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience with API design principles, data serialization formats, and distributed data pipeline architectures.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* Familiarity with data privacy governance, access controls, and secure data handling practices.
* Experience driving large\-scale platform migrations or technical partner integrations across complex organizations.
* Ability to define platform metrics and use quantitative analysis to drive partner adoption, identify integration bottlenecks, and measure developer experience.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration and more).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and execute the product goal and roadmap for the User Feedback ingestion platform, transitioning integrations from high\-touch support to a scalable, self\-service developer platform.
* Design, scale, and maintain high\-throughput, highly reliable ingestion APIs and pipelines capable of processing feedback signals at Google scale.
* Lead the onboarding strategy for Google product teams, enabling them to integrate the feedback "front door" into their applications and directing the migration from legacy ingestion systems.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for platform adoption, ingestion velocity, and data quality. Use data\-driven insights to identify friction points in the developer integration funnel and prioritize platform improvements.
* Create developer portals, self\-service configuration tools, and documentation to minimize integration friction. Partner closely with backend engineering teams in Hyderabad and collaborate with global partner product teams to ensure smooth integrations.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Specialist
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product, demonstrating an understanding of the product(s) and associated business areas. Products often have divisional implications.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product, demonstrating an understanding of the product(s) and associated business areas. Products often have divisional implications. This role also leverages market research and user feedback to influence product direction, innovation, and enhancements throughout the product life cycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provides technical product management services on a product, applying functional technical expertise to improve product results. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Coaches technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of a new technical product. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with organizational strategy and objectives.
* Conducts market research and analyzes consumer trends to identify opportunities for product innovation and enhancement.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to define product features and functions and supports product development execution.
* Prepares detailed product documentation and provides technical support to sales and marketing teams.
* Gathers and incorporates market feedback to evaluate and steer current and future product functionality.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in technical product management or related roles, with 2 years of experience managing projects preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Must have: Appian platform knowledge (other similar platform like Camunda), backlog management, requirements elicitation and definition, Agile / Scrum product ownership, JIRA/Confluence, Roadmap planning.
* Nice to have: Process mapping, stakeholder management, user story writing, testing / UAT coordination, market research and user feedback analysis, product documentation, stakeholder communication.
* Strong verbal and written communication, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem\-solving, Learning Agility abilities.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager. Financial Services or function\-specific experience is an added advantage.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Description**
 Amazon is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development of a new cross\-border business platform. This role will be responsible for building an innovative platform that enables seamless international commerce, working at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and regulatory compliance. You will completely own \& drive the end\-to\-end product vision, strategy, and execution (with technology teams),product adoption for this greenfield initiative that will redefine how businesses engage in cross\-border trade on Amazon.
   

  

 You should enjoy working in a start\-up environment \& will need to develop a deep understanding of cross\-border trade, regulations, logistics, payments and seller/customer needs. You will have to align and coordinate with multiple cross\-functional teams including Legal, Tax, Trade Compliance, Logistics, and Payments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Product Strategy: Define and drive the product strategy for a new cross\-border business platform from concept to launch. Drive both long\-term vision and short\-term execution plans to achieve business results.
* Roadmap Planning and Execution: Provide value\-based prioritization of product development initiatives to ensure maximum ROI, Manage cross\-functional processes for prioritizing, delivering, and launching major product releases
* Requirements Definition: Develop comprehensive product plans, Produce high quality requirements documents and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver key capabilities on time and on budget. Writes user stories to communicate customer needs in an Agile development environment.
* Product Roll\-out: Create and execute go\-to\-market plans for new features. Monitor key performance metrics to ensure product performance and identify optimisation opportunities. Partner with business and marketing teams to drive product adoption
* Cross\-Functional Leadership and Alignment: Collaborate with technology \& functional teams(biz, legal) teams to deliver scalable, world\-class platform solutions. Influence without authority and earn trust across a wide range of technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 A day in the life
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about managing challenging, complex and ambiguous projects across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for a tenured Product leader who shares Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great experience. You will work in a fast\-paced environment, balancing the needs of diverse stakeholders while maintaining focus on delivering customer value and business impact
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* 5\+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience in B2B, high\-tech products/services preferred
* Experience in successful technology product work from ideation through launch
* Good understanding of cross border trade, regulations and compliance requirements


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About the Role** 




 As a Product Consultant for our ERP, you will be at the forefront of ensuring our high\-growth e\-commerce and retail brands operate seamlessly on Fulfil's modern AI integrated ERP platform. This is a hands\-on role where you'll act as the critical bridge between our engineering team and our end customers. You'll dive deep into live operational issues, performing thorough root cause analyses (RCA) by diving deep into the product and leveraging AI for advanced troubleshooting.
 



  





 Beyond reactive problem\-solving, you will proactively identify customer pain points, design and document sustainable solutions, and collaborate intensely with cross\-functional teams at Fulfil to implement improvements. If you thrive on dissecting complex technical challenges, shaping operational workflows, and driving tangible impact for leading merchants, this role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with strategic problem\-solving in a fast\-paced, global environment.
 



  





**How You'll Grow** 



* Growth at Fulfil isn't linear; it's about expanding what you're capable of, not just climbing a ladder.
* As you build mastery in your role, you'll have opportunities to work across functions like Product Consulting, Merchant Success and across Implementations \- depending on where your skills, interests, and impact take you.
* We don't hand out titles. We invest in people who demonstrate their ability to tackle larger challenges, deliver results consistently, and add value beyond their job description. If you do that, we'll create space for you to grow in whatever direction makes sense.



  





 🚨 We're bringing on another batch of Product Consultants for our
 **BLR office.** 
 If you're hungry and can move fast, get in touch. We'll only interview candidates who show sharpness, creativity, and high\-agency thinking from the first interaction. Make it count! DMs on LinkedIn go a long way too 😉
 



  





**Shifts \& Compensation** 



* **Base Salary** 
 : ₹16,00,000 – ₹20,00,000 per annum
* **Base Location:** 
 Bangalore (onsite)
* **Standard Working Hours** 
 : 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (Aligned with EST business hours)



  





**What You’ll Do:** 



* Own Issues from Start to Finish: Investigate, diagnose, and solve complex operational problems—escalating only with thorough root cause analysis.
* Apply Deep System Thinking: Understand how a single change impacts the entire system—tracing issues across modules, code snippets, logs, and merchant workflows.
* Read and Interpret Code: Dive into relevant sections of code or scripts (mostly Python) to pinpoint issues, confirm assumptions, and identify root causes.
* Improve Processes \& Workflows: Spot patterns, initiate process enhancements, and collaborate with Product to reduce recurring issues.
* Drive Projects \& Outcomes: Plan and manage smaller\-scale projects or initiatives that streamline merchant operations, ensuring clear timelines and deliverables.
* Collaborate \& Communicate: Build strong internal partnerships—working closely with engineering, product, and ops—and provide clear, concise updates to merchants.
* Lead \& Execute as a Manager of One: Take ownership of the new and unassigned queue. Proactively manage priorities, ensure SLAs are met, and hold peers accountable.
* Document \& Scale Knowledge: Turn solutions into repeatable frameworks and knowledge\-base articles that accelerate future resolutions.



  





**We’re Looking for Someone With** 



* **2\+ Years of Experience** 
 in SaaS, Supply Chain, or Consulting.
* **AI \& Prompt Engineering skills** 
 – comfortable leveraging modern AI tools to streamline problem\-solving and gather insights
* **Strong critical thinking \& problem\-solving** 
 – you excel at breaking down complex issues and connecting the dots
* **Excellent communication** 
 – superior command of English to serve North American and UK customers
* **Proven project management ability** 
 – organizing tasks, managing timelines, and delivering results
* **Leadership mindset** 
 – taking initiative, maintaining accountability, and demonstrating strong conflict resolution skills
* **Eager to learn** 
 – quick to pick up new technologies, tools, and processes



  





**Nice to Haves:** 



* Took courses in supply chain, accounting, finance, or operations
* Have used Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or marketplaces
* Have worked with eCommerce merchants or understand DTC brands



  





**You Shouldn’t Apply If:** 



* You’re not willing to work onsite in our Bangalore office.
* You prefer routine tasks over end\-to\-end ownership of solutions.
* You’re uncomfortable with fast\-paced environments where accountability is high.
* You avoid digging deep into understanding problems.
* You aren’t ready to lead projects or mentor others.



  





**About Us:** 




 Fulfil is the modern ERP for commerce. Built to power the fastest\-growing eCommerce brands, our platform brings together order management, inventory, accounting, and more, turning complex operations into a strategic advantage.
 



  





 We’re trusted by brands like HexClad, Ridge Wallet, Caraway, and Resident, and backed by people who want to change the way merchant operations are run. We believe in deep work, radical accountability, and building tools that let sharp people move faster.
 



  





**What It’s Really Like to Work at Fulfil** 




 We’re building the ERP that fast\-growing eCommerce brands actually want to use, which means we’re taking on entrenched enterprise software with a small, intense team.
 



  





 Big Tech and VC\-backed startups are 400\-horsepower engines running at 25% efficiency. They have bloated teams, endless meetings, six months to ship a feature. At Fulfil, we’re a 200\-horsepower engine running at 100%. We’re bootstrapped, profitable, and growing steadily. No permission layers. No “alignment meetings” about alignment meetings. Everyone ships everyday.

jobs.title: Lead I - Software Testing- Python Automation + API testing
jobs.description:
**Role description**  

 Job Description


* **Design \& Execute** comprehensive test strategies covering **functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing** for microservices\-based systems
* **Performance \& Load Testing** design, develop, and execute performance test suites using **Gatling** and/or **Locust** to validate system behavior under high\-throughput, high\-concurrency conditions
* **Automate** build and maintain robust automated test frameworks using **Python** and **PyTest**, ensuring high coverage and fast feedback loops
* **Understand the Product** proactively learn functional and business domain knowledge to independently create meaningful, well\-targeted test cases that go beyond surface\-level validation
* **Non\-Functional Testing** contribute to **scalability, reliability, soak, and stress testing** to ensure services meet production\-grade SLAs
* **API Testing** validate RESTful APIs for correctness, error handling, data integrity, and contract compliance
* **Debug \& Investigate** trace test failures across distributed services and cloud infrastructure; collaborate with developers on root cause analysis
* **Collaborate** work closely with developers, product owners, and cross\-functional teams to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and shift quality left
* **CI/CD Integration** integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation
* **Report \& Communicate** produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and quality metrics; flag risks early and advocate for quality across the team
* **Document** maintain test plans, test cases, and testing documentation to ensure traceability and knowledge sharing


**Skill** **Required**


* Professional experience in **software testing / quality engineering**, with a focus on testing scalable, distributed systems
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Python** and the **PyTest** framework for test automation
* Practical experience with **performance testing tools** **Gatling** and/or **Locust** including test script development, execution, and results analysis
* Solid understanding of **different types of testing**: functional, regression, integration, end\-to\-end, smoke, sanity, performance, load, stress, and soak testing
* Experience testing **RESTful APIs and microservices architectures**
* Ability to **quickly grasp functional and business domain knowledge** and translate it into comprehensive, well\-structured test cases
* **Good debugging and analytical skills** comfortable reading application logs, tracing failures across services, and providing clear defect reports with reproduction steps
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** and integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows
* Experience with **Git** and version control workflows
* Basic understanding of **cloud environments** (AWS preferred e.g., EKS, S3, SQS/SNS, Lambda)
* Good communication skills with the ability to **ask the right questions**, clarify requirements, and collaborate effectively with developers and product stakeholders


**Nice to Have**


* Experience testing applications that integrate with **search backends** (Solr, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch)
* Familiarity with **Java** and ability to read/understand Java\-based microservice code
* Experience with **contract testing** (e.g., Pact) or **API specification validation** (OpenAPI/Swagger)
* Exposure to **Bash scripting** for test utilities and automation
* Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes** (EKS) for testing in containerized environments
* Experience with **observability and monitoring tools** (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana) for correlating test results with system behaviuor
* Awareness of **event\-driven architectures** and messaging systems (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments
* Exposure to **accessibility testing** or **security testing** fundamentals
* Experience collaborating with **cross\-functional or globally distributed teams**

 **Skills**  

automation testing,sdet,python,pytest,api testing

 **About UST**

**Role: Sr. Data Engineer**

**Shift Timings: Starts at 6:30PM or 7:30PM IST** 

**Location: Hyderabad (100% onsite \|\| Work from the office from day 1\)**

**Notice Period\- immediate**

**About the Role**

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Science team, you'll be embedded with data scientists and ML engineers to build the data infrastructure that powers Veho's models, experiments, and operational decisions. You'll spend most of your time in DBT and Databricks — designing models, building features, and shipping pipelines that turn raw operational signals into trusted, production\-grade datasets the team relies on every day. Orchestration runs on Airflow, with Prefect in places, and you'll own these workflows end\-to\-end. You’ll be an owner for data models critical to the business to understand the intersection of data science model quality and real\-world performance (e.g., how well do we forecast a driver’s stop time, how effective are we at making our middle mile network adhere to our planning).

Reporting to the **\[PLACEHOLDER: hiring manager title — e.g., Director of Data Science / Senior Manager, Data Science / Tech Lead Manager, Data Science]**, you'll write and maintain data pipelines and tools that ensure our data products not only meet but exceed standards for engineering quality, reliability, and performance. This role is part of Veho's growing India team and partners daily withData Science colleagues across the US and LATAM, Data Platform, Business Insights, and Analytics Engineering

**Responsibilities Include**

* Design and maintain DBT models that produce trusted datasets, features, and metrics the Data Science team relies on for analysis, experimentation, ML, and reporting.
* Build and operate pipelines in Databricks \- PySpark jobs and Delta/Iceberg tables \- that turn raw operational events into analysis\-ready data.
* Develop deep familiarity with Veho's operations so the datasets, schemas, and models you ship reflect how the business actually works.
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end data workflows in Airflow (and Prefect where it fits), with SLAs the DS team can count on for daily models, dashboards, and operational decisions.
* Participate in peer code reviews and raise the bar on data quality, testing, and documentation across the team's models.
* Partner with data scientists to scope, design, and productionize feature pipelines and the model\-supporting data behind them.
* Optimize DBT and Spark workloads for cost, performance, and reliability as Veho's data volume grows.
* Learning new technologies quickly \- nobody comes into this role knowing every piece of the stack. You'll lean on peers, documentation, and experimentation to grow.

**What You BringBuild a strong business**

* **5\+ years of experience** building, testing, and deploying data engineering systems.
* Experience with at least one distributed data system, and the ability to reason about consistency, latency, throughput, and fault tolerance.
* Strong SQL and proficiency with at least one of (py)Spark, DBT, or Airflow in production.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code systems such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi.
* Understanding or strong interest in supply chain and the data challenges it creates.
* A self\-starter who takes initiative, moves fast, and ships while collaborating on big challenges.
* Enthusiastic about working closely with team members to develop creative solutions to novel problems.
* Excellent written and oral communication in English.
* **Tech: DBT, Databricks, (py)Spark, Airflow, Prefect, SQL, Iceberg/Delta; familiarity with the broader Veho stack (Kinesis, EMR, Sigma, Pulumi) a plus.**
* Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) and experienced with AI\-native workflows \- prompting, agentic tooling, evaluations, retrieval \- and willing to bring them into your data engineering practice.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating project activities, gathering and documenting business requirements, tracking project progress, managing stakeholder communication, and ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality software solutions.

The candidate should have experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, coordinating cross\-functional teams, conducting client meetings, managing project timelines, and supporting end\-to\-end software development projects. A basic understanding of APIs, databases, system integrations, and software development processes is highly preferred.

Experience

* **2–6 Years** of experience as a Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, Project Executive, Project Manager, or Software Implementation Consultant.
* Experience in IT Services, SaaS, ERP, CRM, HRMS, or custom software development is preferred.

* Coordinate end\-to\-end software development projects from requirement gathering to deployment.
* Plan and track project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and Product teams to ensure smooth project execution.

Agile \& Scrum Coordination

Technical Coordination

* Work closely with developers to understand APIs, system integrations, and database\-related requirements.
* Coordinate testing activities with QA teams and support defect tracking.
* Assist during deployment, production releases, and post\-deployment support.

Required Skills

* Strong Project Coordination experience.
* Business Requirement Gathering.
* Project Planning and Task Tracking.
* Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Client Communication and Stakeholder Management.
* Team Coordination and Cross\-functional Collaboration.
* Risk and Issue Management.
* Excellent Documentation skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Technical Skills

* Jira

* SQL (Basic knowledge)

* Database concepts

Amazon is seeking a Senior Tax Analyst to join its direct tax reporting team in Hyderabad, India. This position will be responsible for tax reporting and tax compliance of Amazon’s legal entities located in the EMEA region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Working within the EMEA Foreign Reporting \& Compliance team, the Senior Tax Analyst will be required to:  

* Prepare / Review foreign income tax returns and other foreign tax filings and supporting work papers
* Prepare / Review foreign income tax provisions under IFRS and/or Local GAAP
* Prepare / Review estimated tax payments
* Support income tax accounting and reporting under US GAAP for SEC reporting purposes
* Support international tax controversy teams on tax audits
* Work with other stakeholders, including Accounting and Transfer Pricing teams
* Assist with process improvement and automation implementation throughout the foreign tax reporting and compliance process, including use of Artificial Intelligence
* Support regular reporting of key metrics to Management
* Participate in special projects, as necessary
* Support international tax compliance and reporting aspects of mergers and acquisitions (due diligence and integration)

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will support the EMEA International Tax Senior Manager group on the tax reporting (direct tax returns \& tax accounting) as well as on international aspects of the Amazon's worldwide income tax provision. This position will also support the US and international tax controversy teams on audits and the international planning tax team on the compliance and reporting aspects of projects (including M\&A and integration) and will work closely together with the EMEA Accounting teams.
  

  

About the team  

The Amazon tax department is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment. The mission of the EMEA Foreign Reporting \& Compliance team is to comply with foreign local tax reporting requirements and manage the worldwide, tax\-related filings of Amazon’s foreign entities.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree

* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi\-national corporate tax department
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CPA
* Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Experience designing processes to maximize efficiency
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experienced in fulfilling income tax compliance and reporting obligations for US or other multinational organization

* Collaborate team player who is comfortable with a fast paced and dynamic environment

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Senior Analyst - ABAP (SAP Development)
jobs.description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:** a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**


At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.


The Senior Analyst (SAP Development) is responsible for delivering robust, high\-quality SAP ABAP solutions that drive technical excellence and support critical business applications. You will work closely with functional analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into efficient and scalable technical solutions. You will champion coding standards, support ongoing SAP operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the platform. This is a multi\-faceted role with strong opportunities to work across modern SAP technologies.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* **Technical Design:** Collaborate with functional analysts and solution architects to produce comprehensive technical design documents (TDDs) that meet business and system requirements.
* **ABAP Development:** Develop complex, high\-quality ABAP code across all RICEFW object types (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, Workflows) using OO\-ABAP best practices, ensuring code is efficient, scalable, and maintainable.
* **Code Reviews \& Standards:** Conduct thorough peer code reviews, enforce development standards and transport discipline, and drive consistency across the development team through structured governance practices.
* **SAP Integration \& Interfaces:** Design and implement integrations using RFC, ALE/IDoc, and OData services. Work closely with middleware and functional teams to ensure reliable end\-to\-end data exchange between SAP and external systems.
* **Performance Tuning:** Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in ABAP programs, database queries, and SAP applications using tools such as SQL Trace (ST05\), ABAP Trace (SE30\), and Runtime Analysis.
* **Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis:** Investigate and resolve complex technical incidents in the SAP landscape. Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventive measures to reduce future occurrences.
* **Documentation:** Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation including functional specifications, technical design documents, unit test scripts, and change logs to support audits and knowledge transfer.
* **Mentoring \& Knowledge Sharing:** Provide technical mentoring to junior and mid\-level developers, support capability building within the team, and actively contribute to internal knowledge\-sharing sessions and communities of practice.
* **Quality Assurance:** Ensure all ABAP developments are thoroughly unit tested and participate in quality assurance activities including SIT and UAT support to deliver reliable, defect\-free software.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Engage proactively with functional leads across SD, MM, and FI domains to understand business requirements, provide technical feasibility input, and ensure delivered solutions align with process and compliance needs.

**What you’ll bring:**

* **Qualifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; 6–9 years of hands\-on SAP ABAP development experience; SAP certification is an advantage.
* **Core ABAP \& OO\-ABAP:** RICEFW objects, BAdIs, User Exits, Enhancement Framework, ALV, Scripts and Smartforms.
* **Modern SAP Technologies:** OData Services (SAP Gateway/SEGW), CDS Views, AMDP, and good knowledge on SAP UI5 and Fiori.
* **Integration \& Tools:** RFC, ALE/IDoc, EDI, SAP PI/PO awareness; SQL Trace (ST05\), ABAP Runtime Analysis (SE30\), ABAP Debugger.
* **Functional Domain Knowledge:** Sales \& Distribution (SD/AFS), Materials Management (MM), Finance (FI) – understanding of core business processes in each module.
* **Soft Skills \& Competencies:** Strong analytical thinking, excellent written and verbal communication for cross\-functional collaboration, structured problem\-solving mindset, and ability to work independently with minimal oversight.


KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS :

* **On\-Time Delivery:** Percentage of development tasks and project deliverables completed within agreed timelines and within estimated effort.
* **Code Quality:** Reduction in post\-go\-live defects attributable to development activities; adherence to coding standards as measured through peer reviews.
* **Incident \& Change Response:** Average time\-to\-resolution for P1/P2 incidents; first\-time fix rate for production support issues and change requests.
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Positive feedback from functional leads and business stakeholders on technical delivery, communication quality, and responsiveness.

**Why Pentland Brands?**


Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best\-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

**Role description**  

JOB DESCRIPTION  

  

Job Title  

Sr System Analyst
  

  

Job Location  

Bengaluru/ Gurugram  

Requirement Level  

Sr Associate

  


Primary Skill  

SA  

  

JOB RESPONSIBILITY  

  

The business analyst is the individual who has the primary responsibility to elicit, analyze, validate, specify, verify, and manage the real needs of the project stakeholders, including customers and end users. The business analyst is also known as a requirements analyst, requirements engineer, requirements manager, system analyst, or simply analyst. The business analyst serves as the conduit between the customer community and the software development team through which requirements flow. A business analyst is involved at some level throughout the entire system or software development life cycle. Upon establishment of the requirements baseline, the focus is shifted towards the management of the requirements specification and verifying the fulfillment of all requirements. The business analysis function is a project role, not necessarily a job title. The role may be performed by a dedicated BA or split among multiple team members who have other primary job functions, such as a project manager, product manager, or developer. The BA is responsible for seeing that the tasks are performed properly  

  

QUALIFICATION  

  

Bachelor s or master s degree
  

  

EXPERIENCE  

  

Requires an BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.  

An understanding of contemporary requirements elicitation, analysis, specification, verification, and management practices and the ability to apply them in practice; familiarity with requirements engineering books and resources  

An understanding of how to practice requirements engineering according to several software development life cycles in a team environment  

Knowledge of product management concepts and how enterprise software products are positioned and developed  

US Healthcare domain knowledge is a plus, to have credibility with Business stakeholders and be able to work effectively with them
  

Experience in designing and developing process\-based solutions or BPM (business process management)  

Experience in working on various rules and features like Flows, Activities, User Interface, Flow Actions, Agents, SLA, Correspondence, Security, Reports, Listeners (File, MQ), Connectors etc.  

Experience in full PRPC implementation cycle including enterprise Class Structure design and Rulesets design.  

  

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES  

  

Minimum 7 or more years of total experience in designing and solutioning model\-driven, enterprise\-level business applications preferably using mainframe
  

Experience in Business Analysis must have.
  

Healthcare Payer \& Claims specific experience preferred
  

Experience with Change Management preferred
  

Experience in an Agile methodology, including Scrum and KANBAN preferred
  

Analytical skills, to critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high\-level information into details, abstract up from low\-level information to a more general understanding, distinguish presented user requests from the underlying true needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements
  

Facilitation skills, to lead requirements elicitation workshops
  

Observational skills, to validate data obtained via other techniques and expose new areas for elicitation
  

Writing skills, to communicate information effectively to customers, marketing, managers, and technical staff  

Organizational skills, to work with the vast array of information gathered during elicitation and analysis and to cope with rapidly changing information  

Interpersonal skills, to help negotiate priorities and to resolve conflicts among project stakeholders (such as customers, product management, and engineering)  

Modeling skills, to represent requirements information in graphical forms that augment textual representations in natural language, including using modeling languages already established in the development organization

**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Challenges**
 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. Though we engineer for a 50million\+ strong user base, we code with every individual user in mind. While we are quick to adopt the latest in Engineering, we care utmost for security, stability, and automation. Apply if you want to experience the best combination of passionate application development and product\-driven thinking
   

  

**Role**
 As the product manager solving growth focused problems, you will own and drive the vision and road map for products driving customer growth for both PhonePe and PhonePe’s merchant partners. You will be responsible for evangelizing and executing on the road map. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders cutting across, business, technology, regulatory and industry. You will be responsible for defining, designing and detailing these growth solutions. You will also be responsible for delivery of the solutions working with cross\-functional, distributed teams. Finally, you will be key in helping us maintain our product agility and extend our leadership in delivering innovative growth focused solutions that run reliably at scale.
   

  

 This role will require deep problem\-solving acumen as well as strong communication and negotiation skills. Most of all it will require a proven track record of shipping world\-class product solutions, preferably in consumer facing products.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Deep understanding of marketing tech stacks, industry trends, technology development and evolving customer needs

 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. **Job summary** 






 We are seeking Principal Platform Product Manager to define and lead DigiCert's API platform as both an internal engineering standard and externally differentiated developer product. This is a dual access role: inbound, you are the Platform authority who sets API structure, governance, guardrails and developer experience standards that all DigiCert product teams build to. Outbound, you are the thought leader who shapes the developer portal, external API experience and MCP strategy that customers, partners and 3rd party developers depend on. The person in this role will simultaneously be the most demanding internal API standard setter and the most credible external advocate for what a best\-in\-class digital trust API platform can be.

jobs.description:
**About Us :** 




 Media.net is a leading global ad tech company, building innovative products and solutions for advertisers and publishers. Media.net creates the most transparent and efficient path for ad budgets to become publisher revenue, while delivering meaningful value to advertisers, publishers, app developers, and end users across the open web.
 



 We are one of the world’s largest independent contextual advertising businesses, with one of the industry’s most comprehensive advertising technology portfolios. Media.net powers major publishers and ad\-tech platforms across formats, including display, video, mobile, native, search, and local. Our platform manages high\-quality ad supply across 500,000\+ websites and is licensed by the biggest publishers, ad networks, and technology partners worldwide.
 



 Beyond our core advertising business, Media.net also operates at scale in performance\-driven consumer acquisition, app development and distribution, and strategic technology investments. These efforts are supported by one of the world’s largest independent software development engines, enabling us to innovate rapidly and build products used across global markets.
 



 Media.net is home to 1,300\+ employees, with key operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our US headquarters is in New York, and our global headquarters is in Dubai. Across 50\+ demand partners, 21K\+ publishers, and a growing portfolio of products and services, we take great pride in driving trusted, transparent, and scalable results
 



  





**About the Role :** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager to lead privacy and compliance initiatives across Media.net’s advertising platforms.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of adtech, data governance, identity, and platform infrastructure. You will work closely with Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and business teams to build scalable privacy\-aware solutions across our programmatic advertising stack.
 



 The role requires strong understanding of adtech systems, evolving privacy regulations, consent ecosystems, and identity frameworks. You will help translate regulatory and industry changes into product capabilities that can operate reliably at scale.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role with exposure to core platform systems and evolving industry\-wide changes around cookieless advertising, attribution, and privacy\-preserving technologies.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 ● Own and drive privacy and compliance related product initiatives across Media.net’s advertising platforms.
 



 ● Translate evolving regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, DPDPA, and ePrivacy requirements into scalable product and platform capabilities.
 



 ● Work with Engineering teams on consent management, identity systems, data governance, and privacy\-safe measurement solutions.
 



 ● Drive adoption of privacy\-preserving advertising technologies including Privacy Sandbox APIs, contextual targeting, clean room integrations, and first\-party identity strategies.
 



 ● Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on DPIAs, privacy reviews, and regulatory assessments for new platform capabilities.
 



 ● Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to evaluate the impact of signal loss, attribution changes, and privacy constraints on optimization and measurement systems.
 



 ● Work with publisher, revenue, and account management teams to support privacy\-related platform capabilities and customer requirements.
 



 ● Monitor changes across browser ecosystems, IAB standards, identity frameworks, and industry regulations to assess impact on Media.net products.
 



 ● Evaluate external vendors and platforms related to consent management, identity resolution, and privacy tooling.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 4\+ years of Product Management experience in adtech, martech, programmatic advertising, or large\-scale data platforms.
 



 ● Strong understanding of RTB systems, SSP/DSP ecosystem, ad serving infrastructure, and programmatic data flows.
 



 ● Experience working on products involving privacy, compliance, consent management, identity, or data governance.
 



 ● Familiarity with privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging frameworks including DPDPA.
 



 ● Understanding of consent frameworks including IAB TCF and GPP.
 



 ● Comfortable working with APIs, event pipelines, tracking systems, and technical platform teams.
 



 ● Strong execution and cross\-functional stakeholder management skills.

jobs.description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality
* Document business requirements using the company's software development tools and methodology


**Product P\&L and Pricing**
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to manage product profitability and performance, ensuring alignment with short\- and long\-term product objectives and roadmaps


**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**
* Gather customer and user needs, along with market research, to inform the product vision and strategy created by the Product Manager
* Use the product vision and insights to define product features and prioritize the team’s backlog


**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility
* Continuously refine the product backlog by analyzing value versus effort
* Define acceptance criteria and validate that features and stories meet user quality standards
* Drive product development in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and engage stakeholders (e.g., PMs, other POs, functions) to manage dependencies and resolve issues


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 5\+ years of experience in the finance industry, preferably with large\-scale digital, online, or mobile banking applications for consumers or small businesses
* Strong understanding of complex business and technical problems
* Proven experience delivering software products through the definition, design, and release cycle
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with industry standards such as PCI, WCAG, and FFIEC
* Strong leadership, project management, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Deep understanding of user and business needs to create and prioritize user stories that deliver value
* Ability to prioritize based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility

 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI\-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

 The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R\&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.
   

  

**Pre\-requisites**

**Experience**
* 6–9 years of relevant experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 Are you passionate about HR digitalization and SAP SuccessFactors? Do you enjoy working at the intersection of HR processes, data governance, integrations, and business transformation? If yes, this could be your next opportunity.
   

 We are looking for a Product Owner to lead the SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central platform within our People Platform. You will play a key role in shaping the roadmap, governance, and evolution of our core HR systems , ensuring secure, compliant, and seamless master data management across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 We believe you bring
   

 • Strong understanding of HR business processes, co\-worker Lifecyle, Hire to Retire processes, and SAP leading practices.
   

 • Experience working with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central platforms and AI – Joule
   

 • Understanding employee lifecycle management, hire to retire processes, Employee Data structure, global template, Role based permission and security model, data privacy, compliance and Audit governance.
   

 • Strong knowledge of employee data lifecycle management, including hires, job changes, transfers, global assignments, and offboarding.
   

 • Experience managing integrations between SuccessFactors EC and enterprise systems (Data hubs, Payroll, Identity systems, Finance) using APIs, SAP BTP, Data hubs or middleware.
   

 • Proven experience owning and communicating a product roadmap, balancing business priorities, technical debt, and platform evolution.
   

 • Ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, HR Process owners, security, and external vendors.
   

 • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
   

 • 5–8 years of experience in Product Ownership of HR Technology with SAP SuccessFactors implementations.
   

  

 This is our wish list
   

  

 The must\-haves we see for this role are:
   

 • Strong understanding of Employee Central for SAP SuccessFactors, including the design and governance of corporate and country\-specific data models, Foundation Objects (FO), Metadata Framework (MDF), position management, business rules, workflows, Role based permissions and employee data lifecycle management, along with a solid understanding of HR processes and SAP SuccessFactors.
   

 • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors platform and strong expertise in Employee Central module and its integration with enterprise systems such as ADP Payroll, Identity Management, Data hubs other systems using APIs, GCP, SAP BTP/CPI, or middleware platforms.
   

 • Proven product ownership experience managing enterprise applications, defining product roadmaps, prioritizing business requirements, and driving platform enhancements.
   

 • Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes (hire, job changes, transfers, global assignments, offboarding) and their configuration and governance within Employee Central, including workflows, approvals, and data management.
   

 • Strong communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge business, engineering, and vendor teams.
   

 • Good understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, data governance, security models, compliance, audit requirements, and privacy regulations within HR systems.
   

 • Knowledge of People Analytics, reporting, data migration, data quality frameworks, and SAP SuccessFactors core modules (Employee Central, Platform, RBP, Talent, Recruiting, Onboarding etc) and their integrations will be considered a strong advantage.
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 As Product Owner for SAP SuccessFactors (EC), you will own the strategic direction of the platform and ensure it continues to deliver value to HR, business users, and employees globally.
   

 You will work closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, HR Product teams, HR Process Owners and external vendors to continuously improve the platform while maintaining stability, compliance, and operational excellence.
   

 This means you will:
   

 • Work and communicate the product roadmap for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and SAP SuccessFactors Platform.
   

 • Prioritize business requirements, platform enhancements, and operational stability in accordance with business needs.
   

 • Collaborate with Engineering teams to define and deliver scalable business solutions.
   

 • Partner with HR and Product teams to translate business requirements into application capabilities.
   

 • Ensure secure, compliant, and efficient employee data management across the entire employee lifecycle.
   

 • Drive continuous improvements in core HR processes, workflows, automation, and user experience
   

 • Support SAP Half Yearly releases, Upgrades and transformation initiatives affecting the platform.
   

 • Monitor platform health, operational KPIs, service quality, and user satisfaction
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 You will work within the Group Function Digital Area supporting People \& Culture platforms across IKEA's global organization.
   

 Our team is responsible for delivering a world\-class HR platform build on SAP SuccessFactors, enabling secure, compliant, and efficient management of employee master data and organization data throughout the employee lifecycle.
   

 We work closely with HR Product teams, Engineering, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Service Delivery, HR Process Owners and external technology partners to ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.
   

 We believe in:
   

 • Delivering secure and compliant HR Master data and org management.
   

 • Building scalable enterprise platforms.
   

 • Continuous improvement and innovation.
   

 • Strong collaboration across business and technology.
   

 • Ownership and accountability.

 As a Senior Product Owner, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and evolution of our People Management platform — spanning SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, and OpenText for document management and storage.
   

 This role combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution, directly impacting how we manage and serve co\-workers across the organisation.
   

  

 This means that you will:
   

  

 • Define and own the multi\-year product roadmap — balancing business value, cost, risk, and technical sustainability
   

 • Shape a forward\-looking AI and innovation roadmap — identifying where intelligence and automation add real value
   

 • Stay close to market trends and vendor developments — translating them into practical platform direction
   

 • Lead planning and prioritisation — managing cross\-team dependencies across SF EC, OpenText, and adjacent platforms
   

 • Translate business needs into clear solutions and a well\-structured backlog using roadmap tools and Jira
   

 • Drive stakeholder alignment across global business, centres of excellence, and engineering teams
   

 • Act as a trusted advisor to business and digital leadership on platform strategy and trade\-offs
   

 • Ensure platform reliability, compliance, and data integrity across all People Management processes
   

 • Continuously improve platform quality, adoption, and user experience
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 You will work in Group Function Digital Area.
